Owners

Owner questions, thoughtfully answered.

Start here, then talk with Us about the details of your property.

What does Rankin Property Management offer?

Tenant placement, rent collection, maintenance coordination, compliance support, reporting, owner communication, and investor support. The written proposal defines your specific scope.

What are the management plans?

Core Management is listed at 8.9% monthly. Performance Plus is 9.9% monthly. Investor Elite is 7.9–8.5% monthly for three or more properties. Confirm the fee basis and complete terms in your proposal.

What is the leasing fee?

The property management flyer lists a leasing fee of one month’s rent. Discuss how the fee applies to your placement and the scope included.

Can I use tenant placement without ongoing management?

Tenant placement is one of Rankin’s services. Ask Us for a placement-specific proposal and clarify the responsibilities you will keep after move-in.

Do you manage property in my area?

Service availability is confirmed for the property’s address. Use the consultation form or call Us to discuss the location.

How are repairs approved?

Discuss spending limits, estimates, urgent issues, and owner approvals before onboarding. Your agreement should define these responsibilities.

How often will I receive reporting?

Monthly reporting is listed in Core Management. Performance Plus also includes quarterly reviews.

Do you offer a rent or placement guarantee?

Ask Us about any terms that may apply to your proposal. Only guarantees expressly included in a signed agreement apply.

How do I transfer an already occupied rental?

Discuss the existing lease, resident communication, deposits, financial records, open maintenance issues, and the transition plan with Us. Use the designated secure channel for documents.

No matching questions. Ask Us directly.
